text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Harare City Council will fine any company guilty of polluting the city's water courses at least Z$50,000 plus Z$500 a day for the period that the pollution continues.
- Harare businessman and senior vice president of Zimbabwe's black economic empowerment pressure group Affirmative Action Group, Peter Pamire, died in a car accident on Sunday night.

- Zimbabwe's elephant population has increased to proportions the country is unable to sustain properly as a result of the world-wide ban on ivory trade, secretary for environment and tourism July Moyo said on Sunday night.
